content.user_title: Generate ACE Step Music on RunComfy
content.value_statement: Creating affordable AI music often needs endpoint selection, structured lyrics, and repeatable CLI inputs. This skill guides ACE Step generation, inpainting, and outpainting through RunComfy.
actual_capabilities: Chooses between ACE Step base, ACE Step 1.5, audio-inpaint, and audio-outpaint workflows.
Builds tag-driven music prompts with genre, mood, instrument, tempo, and vocal guidance.
Supports structured lyrics with verse, chorus, bridge, outro, and instrumental markers.
Guides time-range audio inpainting for replacing a section inside an existing track.
Guides audio outpainting for adding an intro, outro, or both around an existing track.
Explains RunComfy CLI setup, authentication, output folders, limits, and exit codes.
limitations: Requires the RunComfy CLI, a RunComfy account, and valid authentication.
Generation and editing send prompts or audio URLs to RunComfy services.
Inpainting and outpainting require HTTPS audio URLs supplied for the task.
Each ACE Step call is limited to four minutes of generated or edited audio.

use_cases.title: Draft Background Tracks
use_cases.description: Create low-cost instrumental drafts with specific tags, duration, and mood before final production.

use_cases.title: Repair Song Sections
use_cases.description: Replace a chorus, bridge, intro, or outro without regenerating the full song.

use_cases.title: Extend Short Hooks
use_cases.description: Turn a short musical hook into a longer arrangement with added intro or outro sections.
use_cases.target_user: Game developers and interactive media teams

prompt_templates.title: Generate an Instrumental Draft
prompt_templates.prompt: Use ACE Step to create a 60 second instrumental track for a calm product video. Include genre, mood, instruments, BPM, and no vocals.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Structured Vocal Song
prompt_templates.prompt: Use ACE Step 1.5 to generate a 90 second vocal song. Provide tags, language, section markers, and concise lyrics.

prompt_templates.title: Replace a Problem Section
prompt_templates.prompt: Use ACE Step audio-inpaint to replace seconds 20 to 40 of this audio URL. Match the surrounding style and make the section instrumental.

prompt_templates.title: Extend a Finished Hook
prompt_templates.prompt: Use ACE Step audio-outpaint to add a 20 second intro and 40 second outro to this hook. Keep the original energy and tempo.

output_examples.input: Generate a short lo-fi instrumental for a tutorial intro.
output_examples.output: The skill selects ACE Step base, proposes detailed tags, sets a short duration, and prepares a RunComfy generation workflow.

output_examples.input: Fix the middle section of my track without changing the rest.
output_examples.output: The skill selects audio-inpaint, defines the edit range, matches the tags to the source, and explains the expected output file.

output_examples.input: Make this 30 second hook into a longer background loop.
output_examples.output: The skill selects audio-outpaint, plans added sections before or after the source, and keeps the total length within ACE Step limits.

best_practices: Use specific tags for genre, mood, instruments, tempo, vocals, and production style.
Use fixed seeds when you need reproducible variations or client review cycles.
Confirm rights for supplied lyrics and uploaded source audio before generation.
anti_patterns: Do not use vague prompts like chill music when a style, tempo, and instrument list is needed.
Do not upload private or licensed audio unless you have permission to process it externally.
Do not exceed the four minute ACE Step limit in a single generation request.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates new music and edits existing music with ACE Step models on RunComfy.

faq.question: Does it require a RunComfy account?
faq.answer: Yes. The RunComfy CLI needs authentication before it can run model requests.

faq.question: Can it create vocal music?
faq.answer: Yes. ACE Step 1.5 is recommended for multilingual vocal tracks and structured lyrics.

faq.question: Can it edit only part of a song?
faq.answer: Yes. The audio-inpaint workflow regenerates a selected time range inside an existing track.

faq.question: Can it make a track longer?
faq.answer: Yes. The audio-outpaint workflow can add audio before, after, or around the source track.

faq.question: Where does generated audio go?
faq.answer: The RunComfy CLI downloads generated files into the output directory chosen for the request.
